about_the_game:
1 minute Commuting to school is a 2D real-time attack (RTA) action game where players race to school while avoiding obstacles. The goal is to reach school as quickly as possible, trying again and again to get the fastest time.

The main character wakes up almost late and hurries to school. Players can choose a bat to move slower but easier, or a bicycle to go faster but with more difficulty. The route is full of enemies, obstacles, and food items. Eating food raises the score, as the character skipped breakfast. There are many paths to discover.

With simple controls and fast gameplay, the game is fun for both casual players and speedrunners. It is available for download on Steam.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (Rosetta compatible)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics supporting Metal (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in sound card compatible

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or equivalent AMD processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4400 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
